# Millennium Helpers

Millennium Helpers is a cross-platform command-line toolkit for installing, configuring, diagnosing, and integrating Millennium. This site is the user guide for setup, commands, troubleshooting, search, and architecture.

## Documentation

- Home: https://bolens.github.io/millennium-helpers/
- Install: https://bolens.github.io/millennium-helpers/install/
- Guide: https://bolens.github.io/millennium-helpers/guide/
- Help and troubleshooting: https://bolens.github.io/millennium-helpers/help/
- Search: https://bolens.github.io/millennium-helpers/search/
- Architecture: https://bolens.github.io/millennium-helpers/architecture/
- Changelog: https://bolens.github.io/millennium-helpers/changelog/

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/bolens/millennium-helpers
- Issues: https://github.com/bolens/millennium-helpers/issues
